entrypoints.transport: Parent independently emits OUTPUTS.json once after closure; this source never writes OUTPUTS.json

request.originals: Exactly three ordered objects {filename,path,bytes,sha256}; paths /originals/<exact selected filename>; fixed declarations in bridge.ORIGINALS
request.source_authentication: bridge.verify_inputs verifies all three original bytes and the six literal source pins before original-consuming MATLAB entrypoints; independent custody, budget, image and original-clock admission remain provider requirements

preparation.source_status: Raw preparation remains identity-incomplete even if every array exports
preparation.finalizer: python bridge.py validate-preparation --root /output --identity <authenticated document> --identity-sha256 <independently admitted pin>
preparation.admitted_manifest: admitted-preparation.json, emitted fresh only after complete structural validation, exact cross-variant consistency, identity-document binding and actual common-delay timing checks
preparation.row_order: variant outer for imaging, animal source ordinal, standard_minus2, standard_minus1, reversal1, reversal2
preparation.ordinal_rules: animal_ordinal is zero-based. All fields explicitly named source_ordinal, original_ordinal, within_selected_day_ordinal and ordinal are one-based. Positional acquisition chunks are not automatically authenticated acquisition IDs.

arrays.beh: float64 [140,5], all original behavioral columns, never query features
arrays.lick_events_seconds: float64 [N,1], complete original lick-list order, seconds relative first odor; no sorting/imputation
arrays.spks: float64 [all original ROI,140,402]; prospective primary neural signal
arrays.roistats: Recursive inert typed pack of every original ROI metadata field, not identity manufactured from array index

preparation.descriptor: {path,dtype,shape,fortran_order,bytes,sha256}; float64 original numeric exports additionally have nan_mask descriptor and original_class
preparation.orientation: Original MATLAB axes, NPY v1 Fortran-order; no model object, pickle or executable header
preparation.variant_metadata: Two ordered records {variant,status,frametimes,p,rundatetime,clock_kind,physical_acquisition_clock_authenticated}; frametimes preserves original vector orientation, p/rundatetime use inert typed packing
preparation.admitted_clock: Each admitted imaging row.clock contains frametimes descriptor, common_delay_verified, first_odor_offset_verified, second_odor_onset_verified, first_odor_offset_seconds and identity_evidence_sha256. Flags require independent identity document plus actual temporal cell support in [first-odor offset, minimum second-odor onset).

identity_document.identity_boundary: Exact source ordinal, complete ordered trial/ROI joins and common-clock assertions must come from independently authenticated evidence. SHA256 pinning is necessary but is not authentication of the evidence authority. Provider must verify the independent review receipt. No private identity-key body is read or emitted by this implementation work.

reference.ledger: call-ledger.initial.json, per-call started/completion JSON, final call-ledger.json; original failed/partial MAT artifacts preserved
reference.literal_order: behavior; source preprocessing sequence169,sequence247,time,odor,information; no smoothing/flooring sequence169,sequence247,time,odor,information; exact export_values only after all 11 complete
reference.source_rules: Exact pinned functions, source rng Default resets, source 10000-cell branch and NaN-padded odor fits unchanged
reference.index: Zero-based index within one animal's family shape; ordinal is zero-based flattened full output
reference.undefined_kind: structural or computed; computed NaN cause remains unaudited. Any source fit failure remains failed rather than undefined.
reference.axis_names: Exact original contract names and source-ordered 23/11 rosters in bridge.py; shorter caller aliases require explicit mapping

prospective_fit.training_metadata_extras: Accepted from trusted owner: family,rows,groups,null,feature_support,both_classes,query_labels_exposed and fold metadata
prospective_fit.arrays: values[N,C,15],missing[N,C,15] uint8, labels[N,1],trial_group[N,1],clock[N,5] iff permitted; C/Fortran order admitted; missing values represented by zero with true mask
prospective_fit.groups: 118 or119 complete outer-training trials, five windows each. inner_folds has six {train_groups,validation_groups}, local zero-based indices. Validation groups partition all outer-training groups; parent binds exact purged source folds.
prospective_fit.output: MODEL_PARAMETERS.json envelope h_svm_export_v1 with status complete/incomplete, parameters h_svm_parameters_v1, arrays, native_training_margins and all121 attempts; fit-ledger.json and per-attempt records preserved
prospective_fit.parameter_shapes: mean/scale/all_missing[F], beta[D] or support_vectors[K,D]/signed_alpha[K]; bias/threshold/gamma scalar []; Fortran-order inert NPY
prospective_fit.decision: Class B iff native class1 raw margin minus chosen threshold >= 0
prospective_fit.roundtrip: native_training_margins contains threshold-centered class1 scores in original N-row training order. Parent compiler independently evaluates finite margin and >=0 class parity before MODEL.json/RESULT.json publication. No query labels or query-driven formula selection.
prospective_fit.native_qualification: Exact literal R2021a options, custom kernel API, convergence properties and native training-roundtrip remain unexecuted and unqualified; unknown or failed conditions produce incomplete output
